RagShortTexts: The legend of Gnart Nar village is where Nar’s head is located.

Variants.Content: Gnart Nar is a village near the legendary duel site in Battania where Nar is said to have left his head. Known for their skills as foresters, the local villagers help protect the heart of Battania from attacks by the Sturgians and other marauders at the fortress of Ca Bances on the nearby cliffs.
